description: Canonical registry of callable Cloud Function names. Names use the domain.action convention per docs/api-guidelines.md; this file is the single source of truth for function names across iOS, Android, backend, and admin. Every callable must verify authentication context and App Check in production, and return error codes from contracts/errors/errors.json. The status field tracks migration progress (planned vs implemented).

accessLevels.member: Requires active member_monthly entitlement; suspension always overrides entitlement.
accessLevels.admin: Requires admin or owner role; does not require member subscription.

functions.name: auth.completeOnboarding
functions.description: Marks onboarding complete for the calling user; backend writes onboardingCompletedAt and consent timestamps. Deployed via grouped export as auth-completeOnboarding (functions/src/auth/completeOnboarding.ts).

functions.name: subscription.verify
functions.description: Verifies the caller's store subscription receipt and updates the backend-managed entitlement.

functions.name: live.startSession
functions.description: Starts a live location sharing session with a chosen duration (see contracts/schemas/live-location.schema.json liveLocationStartRequest).

functions.name: live.updatePosition
functions.description: Writes the caller's latest position (liveLocationUpdateRequest). Target storage is RTDB liveLocation/{uid}/latest.

functions.name: live.stopSession
functions.description: Stops the caller's active session (liveLocationStopRequest).

functions.name: live.hideMeNow
functions.description: Immediately stops all of the caller's sessions and removes the latest position.

functions.name: drives.save
functions.description: Saves a completed drive: computes distanceMeters/durationSeconds/averageSpeed server-side from the submitted route points (implausible GPS jumps filtered), writes rides/{rideId}, and returns the canonical member-gated Cloud Storage paths (rideRoutes/{uid}/{rideId}/) for the client route/preview upload. Idempotent per sourceSessionId. No top-speed is ever stored. Deployed via grouped export as drives-save (functions/src/drives/saveDrive.ts).

functions.name: drives.delete
functions.description: Deletes an owned drive: removes the rideRoutes/{uid}/{rideId}/ Cloud Storage files first, then the rides/{rideId} document. Available to any active owner — membership not required (legacy parity: free users can delete drives saved during a previous membership). Deployed via grouped export as drives-delete (functions/src/drives/deleteDrive.ts).

functions.name: crownHunt.submitClaim
functions.description: Submits a Kronjakt point claim with the full ported anti-fraud chain: feature flag, entitlement, idempotent replay (SHA-256-scoped key = claim doc ID), point availability, server-side geofence with accuracy buffer, <=1.4 m/s stopped-speed check, position freshness (<=60 s), repeat rules (once/daily/weekly), 10/day limit, rate/velocity/jump risk scoring (>=60 -> risk_review, no points). Eligibility failures return result codes with Swedish messages, not errors. Awards commit atomically with the claim record via the Kronpoäng ledger transaction. Deployed via grouped export as crownHunt-submitClaim (functions/src/crownHunt/submitClaim.ts).

functions.name: crownHunt.createPoint
functions.description: Creates a draft Kronjakt point (title <=100, geofence 20-150 m, reward 1-1000 KP, repeat rule, optional availability window). Audited. Deployed via grouped export as crownHunt-createPoint (functions/src/crownHunt/managePoints.ts).

functions.name: crownHunt.updatePoint
functions.description: Edits a draft or paused point (active/ended points are immutable); merged fields re-validated. Audited with changedFields. Deployed via grouped export as crownHunt-updatePoint (functions/src/crownHunt/managePoints.ts).

functions.name: crownHunt.activatePoint
functions.description: Safety-gated activation: requires safeLocationConfirmed and an approval note (>=3 chars) recorded in the audit entry; stamps approvedAt/approvedByUserId. Ended points cannot be activated. Deployed via grouped export as crownHunt-activatePoint (functions/src/crownHunt/managePoints.ts).

functions.name: crownHunt.pausePoint
functions.description: Pauses a point (ended points cannot be paused). Audited. Deployed via grouped export as crownHunt-pausePoint (functions/src/crownHunt/managePoints.ts).

functions.name: events.create
functions.description: Creates a draft event. Writes the teaser-safe events/{eventId} document and the member-gated events/{eventId}/details/private document (exact location, description) atomically, plus an adminAuditEvents record. Deployed via grouped export as events-create (functions/src/events/manageEvent.ts).

functions.name: events.update
functions.description: Partially updates a draft or published event across both event documents; cancelled/completed events are immutable. Writes an adminAuditEvents record with changedFields. Deployed via grouped export as events-update (functions/src/events/manageEvent.ts).

functions.name: events.publish
functions.description: Publishes a draft event after validating title, approximateArea, and a future start time. Deployed via grouped export as events-publish (functions/src/events/eventLifecycle.ts).

functions.name: events.cancel
functions.description: Cancels a draft or published event with a required reason; sets cancelledAt, never hard-deletes. Deployed via grouped export as events-cancel (functions/src/events/eventLifecycle.ts).

functions.name: events.complete
functions.description: Marks a published event completed; going-RSVP attendees receive badge attendance credit (first_event / five_events, Phase 9f). Deployed via grouped export as events-complete (functions/src/events/eventLifecycle.ts).

functions.name: events.postChatMessage
functions.description: Posts a plain-text message (<=1000 chars) to a published event chat. Requires an active member with a going/maybe RSVP; enforces ~5 messages/30s per user. Writes events/{eventId}/messages with denormalized author display name. Deployed via grouped export as events-postChatMessage (functions/src/events/postChatMessage.ts).

functions.name: events.reportChatMessage
functions.description: Reports a chat message (reason enum + optional details <=500 chars). Deduplicates per message+reporter+reason; own messages cannot be reported; reporter identities are never client-readable. Writes events/{eventId}/messageReports. Deployed via grouped export as events-reportChatMessage (functions/src/events/reportChatMessage.ts).

functions.name: events.removeChatMessage
functions.description: Soft-removes a chat message (moderation): blanks the member-visible body, sets moderationState removed, resolves open reports, and preserves the original text in an adminAuditEvents record. Never hard-deletes. Deployed via grouped export as events-removeChatMessage (functions/src/events/removeChatMessage.ts).

functions.name: garage.addVehicle
functions.description: Adds a vehicle to the caller's garage (max 5 per user, enforced transactionally). Strict schema: make/model/modelYear/powertrain/engineDescription/description/color only — registration numbers, VIN, insurance, and location are unrepresentable because vehicles/{vehicleId} is authenticated-readable. Deployed via grouped export as garage-addVehicle (functions/src/garage/manageVehicle.ts).

functions.name: garage.updateVehicle
functions.description: Partially updates an owned vehicle, including setting/clearing imagePath (validated against the caller's own vehicleImages/{uid}/{vehicleId}/ prefix). Ownership failures return not-found to avoid existence probing. Deployed via grouped export as garage-updateVehicle (functions/src/garage/manageVehicle.ts).

functions.name: garage.deleteVehicle
functions.description: Deletes an owned vehicle: removes the vehicleImages/{uid}/{vehicleId}/ storage prefix first, then the document. Deployed via grouped export as garage-deleteVehicle (functions/src/garage/manageVehicle.ts).

functions.name: badges.awardHelpfulMember
functions.description: Manually awards the helpful_member badge (the only manually awardable key). Requires a non-empty reason; writes an adminAuditEvents record on first award only; idempotent repeats never duplicate audit entries; suspended/deleted targets rejected. Deployed via grouped export as badges-awardHelpfulMember (functions/src/badges/awardHelpfulMember.ts).

functions.name: points.adminAdjust
functions.description: Admin Kronpoäng adjustment (credit or debit): positive integer amount, mandatory reason (<=500), debits never overdraft, only an owner may adjust another owner. Runs through the internal transaction primitives and writes an adminAuditEvents record. Deployed via grouped export as points-adminAdjust (functions/src/points/adminPoints.ts).

functions.name: points.adminReverse
functions.description: Reverses a ledger entry with a compensating reversal entry (deterministic ID: one reversal per original, replay-safe). Reversals cannot be reversed; an overdrafting reversal is rejected; writes an adminAuditEvents record in the same transaction. Deployed via grouped export as points-adminReverse (functions/src/points/adminPoints.ts).

functions.name: partners.submitApplication
functions.description: Submits a partner application (contact data, never client-readable). Duplicate-spam guard: one active application per user or contact email. Deployed via grouped export as partners-submitApplication (functions/src/partners/applications.ts).

functions.name: partners.reviewApplication
functions.description: Admin review flow: start_review, approve (creates the draft company in the same transaction, idempotent), or reject (note required). Every step audited. Deployed via grouped export as partners-reviewApplication (functions/src/partners/applications.ts).

functions.name: partners.createCompany
functions.description: Creates a draft partner company (legacy field limits; logoPath under companyImages/{companyId}/). Audited. Deployed via grouped export as partners-createCompany (functions/src/partners/manageCompany.ts).

functions.name: partners.updateCompany
functions.description: Edits a draft or paused company (active/ended are immutable). Audited with changedFields. Deployed via grouped export as partners-updateCompany (functions/src/partners/manageCompany.ts).

functions.name: partners.setCompanyStatus
functions.description: Company lifecycle transitions: activate | pause | end (ended is terminal). Audited. Deployed via grouped export as partners-setCompanyStatus (functions/src/partners/manageCompany.ts).

functions.name: partners.createOffer
functions.description: Creates a draft offer with the three-tier privacy split: teaser document, member detail subdocument, and the backend-only discount code. Audited (the code value never appears in audit details). Deployed via grouped export as partners-createOffer (functions/src/partners/manageOffer.ts).

functions.name: partners.updateOffer
functions.description: Edits a draft or paused offer across the three documents; merged availability window re-validated. Audited with changedFields (names only). Deployed via grouped export as partners-updateOffer (functions/src/partners/manageOffer.ts).

functions.name: partners.setOfferStatus
functions.description: Offer lifecycle transitions: activate | pause | end (ended/expired are terminal). Audited. Deployed via grouped export as partners-setOfferStatus (functions/src/partners/manageOffer.ts).

functions.name: partners.showOfferCode
functions.description: Reveals an active offer's discount code to an active member — the ONLY place the code ever appears; never logged (legacy rule). Deployed via grouped export as partners-showOfferCode (functions/src/partners/manageOffer.ts).

functions.name: partnerInsights.recordInteraction
functions.description: Records one partner interaction event with a PARTNER-SCOPED user hash (raw UIDs never stored), deduped to one event per company+type+UTC-day+user via a deterministic document ID. anonymous_pass_by requires the partnerInsightsPassBy flag (contract default OFF) AND the caller's anonymousPartnerStatsOptIn — non-opted-in contributions return { recorded: false } silently so opting out is unobservable. Events expire after 7 days; the scheduled partnerInsights-aggregateDaily writes threshold-enforced aggregates (min 10 unique contributors for pass-by, config can only raise) and partnerInsights-cleanupExpired removes expired raw events. Deployed via grouped export as partnerInsights-recordInteraction (functions/src/partnerInsights/recordInteraction.ts).

functions.name: admin.suspendUser
functions.description: Suspends a user (moderation): sets the suspended custom claim, mirrors users/{uid}.suspended, and writes immutable moderationActions and adminAuditEvents records with actor, target, reason, and server timestamp. Deployed via grouped export as admin-suspendUser (functions/src/admin/suspendUser.ts).

functions.name: admin.restoreAccess
functions.description: Restores a suspended user: clears the suspended custom claim, mirrors users/{uid}.suspended, and writes immutable moderationActions and adminAuditEvents records. Deployed via grouped export as admin-restoreAccess (functions/src/admin/restoreAccess.ts).

functions.name: admin.setFeatureFlag
functions.description: Sets a feature flag value. Flag keys are defined in contracts/features/feature-flags.json.

functions.name: admin.setAdminRole
functions.description: Grants or revokes the admin custom claim and mirrors it to users/{uid}.role. No client self-elevation: callers can never change their own role, and owner accounts are never modified. Writes an immutable adminAuditEvents record. Deployed via grouped export as admin-setAdminRole (functions/src/admin/setAdminRole.ts).
